inputs.share_count_basis: Weighted-average diluted shares for H1 FY2026 (1,325.990m basic + 1.876m restricted shares assumed vested), Interim Report 2026 note 12(b). Held FLAT: SBC is expensed in the flows. Repurchases under the RMB2-5bn programme announced Aug-2026 continue after 30 June and will lower the count; not credited (value-neutral in this model, and the cash is not yet spent).
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 Annual Report cash-flow add-back 'Share-based payment' RMB71.604m (9992.HK_Annual_FY2025.txt:1526); no equity-award tax withholding line disclosed (HK restricted-share scheme settled from trust-held shares). H1 FY2026 SBC RMB55.5m = 0.32% of revenue, used as the forward anchor.
inputs.fx_note: Flows and statements in RMB (CNY); price in HKD on HKEX. fx_rate = HKD per CNY = 1.1744 (Yahoo CNYHKD=X, regularMarketTime 2026-10-23T21:58Z). Cross-check via USD legs at the same time: USDHKD 7.8413 / USDCNY 6.6606 = 1.1773, a 0.25% tie (timing). No dual listing exists for a price parity check. All per-share values are computed in CNY and converted to HKD; refresh_price.py does not move this rate, so re-fetch it on any later refresh.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the flows' currency: China 10y CGB ~1.8% + beta ~1.3 x China ERP ~6.5% = ~10.3% cost of equity, rounded to 10.5%; no financial debt so WACC = cost of equity. Same rate in all three scenarios: fad/single-IP risk is charged in the bear driver path and its 30% weight, not in a WACC premium (risk charged once).
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B), leases as operating cost. IFRS-16 EBITDA is charged lease_cost_pct (principal 'Payment of lease liabilities' + lease interest: H1 FY2026 502.9 + 81.1 = RMB584m = 3.40% of revenue; FY2025 608.3 + 81.9 = 1.86%). Lease liabilities (RMB3.73bn at 30-Jun-2026) are EXCLUDED from net debt. D&A path is ex right-of-use depreciation (FY2025 1,118 - 593 = RMB525m = 1.4%; H1 FY2026 821 - 452 = RMB369m = 2.15%).
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows are consolidated; NCI (H1 FY2026 profit share RMB62m, ~1.2% of group profit) deducted once in the equity bridge at ~10x annualised NCI profit (RMB1,250m), not at its RMB229m book value.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF DCF, component route, with the non-US adaptations (CNY/HKD currency, IFRS-16 leases, NCI, non-operating assets). Pop Mart is an asset-light branded-IP consumer operating company, so the routing table's operating-company row applies; no bank/REIT/holdco features. Net cash anchor: the 31-Dec-2025 cash + term deposits (RMB17,225m) less the H1 FY2026 shareholder distributions actually paid (final dividend RMB3,149m + buybacks RMB1,546m) = RMB12,530m. The 30-Jun-2026 balance sheet shows RMB14,164m (12,442 cash + 1,520 + 202 term deposits) but it already contains ~RMB1.6bn of H1 FY2026 owner FCF, and year 1 of the projection is the full FY2026, so using June cash would count H1 cash twice. Restricted cash (RMB227m) excluded. Interest income (FY2025 RMB159m) stripped from the FCF base because net cash > 1x FCF base. Buybacks: actual repurchaser (RMB1.55bn in H1 FY2026, RMB2-5bn programme announced Aug-2026), so the flat count is being funded. FY0 FY2025 owner FCF margin 25.5% sits on a tax-payment lag (FY2025 cash tax RMB4.08bn vs H1 FY2026 RMB3.22bn catch-up) and peak LABUBU operating leverage; it is NOT carried forward. Forward margins are built from components with H1 FY2026 as the anchor (EBITDA margin 43.9% incl. RMB720m FX loss).

equity_bridge.note: Interim Report 2026 balance sheet, 30-Jun-2026; income from these is not in the projected EBITDA margin path

equity_bridge.item: Non-controlling interests at ~10x annualised NCI profit

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR 29.4% diverges by far more than 30% from revenue (71.3%) and EPS (85.2%) 5yr CAGRs. Every historical CAGR is dominated by the FY2024-FY2025 LABUBU surge (FY2025 revenue +184.7%) and none is used to drive the projection; driver paths are built from H1 FY2026 actuals and management's withdrawn-in-practice 20% FY2026 target.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series = reported FCF - SBC - interest income (FY2020 477.8, FY2022 378.0, FY2025 9,463.0). Owner-FCF 3yr CAGR (192.5%) is ABOVE reported (161.3%) because FY2022's interest income and SBC were a large share of a weak base year; SBC is not outgrowing cash flow here (0.19% of FY2025 revenue). FY2022 shows the downside: owner FCF margin ~1% after lease payments when growth stalled.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 +1%: H1 +23.8% (RMB17.17bn) then H2 ~-12% YoY against the Q3-2025 LABUBU peak (H2 FY2025 RMB23.24bn), consistent with the CEO saying the 20% target is very likely missed and H2 pressure exceeding H1. FY2027 -6% as overseas (APAC -9.7%, Americas -16.5% in H1) keeps normalising and China's +47% laps. Recovery to mid-single digits from FY2028 on IP-matrix breadth (six IPs > RMB2bn) and store roll-out, fading to 3%.
base.margin_rationale: EBITDA margin 43% FY2026 (H1 43.9% incl. RMB720m FX loss; H2 deleverages on falling sales), settling at 37% vs FY2024 38.5% and FY2023 30.1%; gross margin guided down 1-2pp. Owner-FCF margin matures ~22%, between FY2023 (~15%) and FY2024 (~28%).
base.cash_tax_rate_note: 25% normal (FY2025 tax expense 4,025 / PBT ~17,040 = 23.6%; PRC 25%, HK 16.5%, overseas mix plus dividend withholding). FY2026 raised to ~34% (bull 33%, bear 36%, bear FY2027 28%) for the cash catch-up on FY2025 profits: current income-tax liability fell RMB2,116m -> RMB623m in H1 FY2026 and H1 cash tax paid was RMB3,220m vs RMB1,190m a year earlier. Without this the FY2026 owner-FCF margin (26%) would sit far above H1 FY2026's actual ~12.7% (OCF 3,637 - capex 724 - lease 584 - SBC 55 - interest 93 = RMB2,181m), which is also depressed by a RMB953m trade-payables unwind not modelled as recurring.

scenario_narratives.base: LABUBU cools from fad peak to a durable franchise rather than collapsing. FY2026 grows ~1% as H1's +23.8% is given back by an H2 decline against the Q3-2025 peak; FY2027 falls ~6% as Asia Pacific and the Americas keep normalising and China laps +47%. From FY2028 the IP matrix (SKULLPANDA, CRYBABY, MOLLY, DIMOO, HIRONO each > RMB2bn) and measured overseas store roll-out return the group to mid-single-digit growth on a revenue base still ~2.7x FY2024. Margins give back the 2025 operating leverage: EBITDA 43% -> 37%, lease costs ~3.2% of revenue as flagship overseas stores mature, owner-FCF margin ~22%.
scenario_narratives.bull: The 'pit-lane' year is just that: H2 FY2026 dips only modestly, the Sony LABUBU film (Paul King) and POP LAND extend the IP's half-life Disney-style, and a second IP breaks out internationally so single-IP share falls well below 38%. Americas/Europe resume double-digit growth from an early-stage store base; revenue compounds ~10% a year through FY2030 and margins hold ~43% EBITDA as overseas mix recovers and counterfeit enforcement protects pricing.
scenario_narratives.bear: The blind-box fad follows the Beanie Babies/Squishmallows arc. H1 FY2026's overseas declines (APAC -9.7%, Americas -16.5%) spread to China once the +47% lap is gone; 'Lafufu' counterfeits erode pricing and exclusivity; no successor IP replaces LABUBU's ~RMB14bn. Revenue falls ~40% from FY2025 to ~RMB22bn by FY2029 (still above FY2024's RMB13bn), store and lease costs deleverage, and EBITDA margin compresses to 26% -- towards FY2022's trough economics -- before low-single-digit growth resumes.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised to 30% from the 15% house default because ~38% of FY2025 revenue sits on one IP family in a historically boom-bust category and the first overseas regional declines are already in the H1 FY2026 print. Base 45%: the IP matrix and China momentum make a soft landing the single likeliest outcome. Bull cut to 25% because it needs several independent things to go right (film success, a second global IP, overseas re-acceleration, margin hold).

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value Pop Mart as a branded-IP consumer company coming off a fad-driven peak, not as a compounder: the FY2025 RMB37bn revenue and 48% EBITDA margin are treated as a high-water mark, the forward path is anchored on H1 FY2026 actuals and the CEO's own admission that 20% growth will be missed, and the single-IP risk is carried explicitly by a deep bear case (revenue -40%, margins to 26%) at 30% weight. Terminal values are capped at 12x owner FCF, appropriate to a trend-sensitive discretionary business.
key_risks_to_valuation: LABUBU/THE MONSTERS concentration (~38% of FY2025 revenue): a faster cooling than the base case moves value toward the bear case
H2 FY2026 run-rate is unobserved; the base assumes H2 revenue -12% YoY and FY2026 +1%. A Citi-style -8% FY2026 would sit between base and bear
Counterfeiting ('Lafufu') eroding pricing power and gross margin beyond the guided 1-2pp
Lease commitments rising fast (RMB3.73bn, up 30% in six months) into slowing overseas demand: deleverage risk on flagship stores
FX: CNY/HKD 1.1744 bridge and overseas revenue translation; H1 FY2026 booked RMB720m FX losses
Upside: buyback of RMB2-5bn at depressed prices lowers the share count, which this model does not credit
